c74object.name: evi.bp~
c74object.description:
evi.bp~ is a 'max define' for the evi_bp.gendsp gen~ abstraction. Because evi.bp~ is a 'max define' it also accepts all messages and attributes that a gen~ object does.
A linear twopole resonant bandpass filter, a port of [bp~] from Pd and therefore a direct form biquad. Similar to reson~ and evi.reson~ but with no feedforward gains and thus a special and smooth alternative to those filters. Like reson etc it can take very high Q values which is one of it's primary use cases. [bp~] is basically a control rate version of [vcf~] from Pd, which is also ported in evieve as evi.vcf~.

inlet.digest: Inlet #2: Cutoff in Hz @min samplerate*0.00022 @max samplerate*0.458334
inlet.description: Center frequency of the resonant peak.
Filter resonance. Can be increasingly high values (e.g. 10000).

attribute.name: filter
attribute.description: Gain filter off/on. If off (the default) identical to Pd [bp~] (no gain inlet). If on, ± gain inlet takes effect. Switching this also resets internal filter (biquad) state.

c74object.discussion: For more information about other reimplementations of Pd filters in evieve, see the 'evieve pd' tab of the helpfile.
